items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: INTERVIEWER: You know, I hear that some of the modern, some of the extreme moderns, like I believe Monk is interested in recording Jelly Roll tunes. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah?

ctx.x: Good. I spent a couple of nights in New York, see if I can catch any music. I don't know. I was looking at the New Yorker, but I don't see too much on it. I'd like to hear some of the modern bands, you know, I mean, there's some who are interested in that as well.
You know, I hear that some of the modern, some of the extreme moderns, like I believe Monk is interested in recording Jelly Roll tunes.
